annotation.interpretation_a: An endpoint might choose to implement RFC1191/RFC1981 PMTU discovery, but is not required to.
annotation.interpretation_b: An endpoint might choose *not* to implement RFC1191/RFC1981 PMTU discovery, relying solely on Packetization Layer PMTU Discovery.
annotation.justification: The sentence structure allows for two interpretations of the scope of the 'MAY'. It could mean that endpoints MAY use *either* Packetization Layer PMTU Discovery or RFC1191/RFC1981 PMTU Discovery, or it could mean that endpoints SHOULD use Packetization Layer PMTU Discovery, and MAY *also* use RFC1191/RFC1981 PMTU Discovery. This impacts implementation choices.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the 'MAY' applies to both Packetization Layer PMTU Discovery and RFC1191/RFC1981 PMTU Discovery, or only to the latter. This affects whether endpoints are expected to always use the first method, or if they can choose to use neither.
